results.name: Joostmod - Official Terraria Mods Wiki
results.snippet: The Joostmod is a variety content mod , filled with whatever I felt like adding at the time. It adds over 400 new items, 14 new enemies, 5 new bosses , 10 new minibosses known as hunts, 2 new town NPCs, and 11 new modifiers.

results.name: Joostmod/Bosses - Official Terraria Mods Wiki
results.snippet: The Joostmod adds 5 bosses to Terraria : The Alpha Cactus Worm, the Grand Cactus Worm, the Jumbo Cactuar, the SA-X, and Gilgamesh and Enkidu.

results.name: Jumbo Cactuar - Official Terraria Mods Wiki
results.snippet: The Jumbo Cactuar, also known as the Gigantuar, is the first post-Moon Lord boss added by the Joostmod . It is summoned by using a Mustachioed Cactus in the desert. The Jumbo Cactuar runs toward the player while firing needle volleys. Each cluster deals 10 damage and ignores defense and invincibility frames. It may also leap into the air in an act to stomp on the player using its massive hitbox ...
